title: Abyssals v0.90.35 — Two-Parent Inheritance
notes: Same-family parents each independently roll for every original Prodigy bonus they carry. One carrier keeps its 33.176% base chance; two carriers give 55.345%. Nursery items boost each carrier’s roll and pairing previews show the combined per-stat and all-trait odds. If both succeed, keep the stronger original bonus once; if only one succeeds, inherit that parent’s original bonus. No bonus addition or evolution inflation. Existing eggs, offspring, saves, permanent growth, quests, lives, prices and original APK signing are preserved.
